# comfyui-MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize-T8 v0.4.0

## 中文

- 新增显式授权的 SGLang Omni/vLLM OpenAI 兼容远程推理连接，密钥不会写入工作流。
- 新增自定义语言提示、字幕后处理/CPS 报告、WebVTT/RTTM 导出，以及基于重叠证据的可选跨分片说话人关联。
- 新增独立 Whisper 词级对齐与 WavLM X-Vector 跨分块声纹关联，共十五个 V3 节点；辅助模型按固定 revision 惰性加载并可独立释放。
- 新增固定 FLEURS 来源、SHA-256 provenance 与 30 分钟带噪真实人声回归，并把自动兼容覆盖扩展到 Python 3.13、PyTorch 2.13.0 和 Transformers 5.16.1。
- Registry 元数据增加最低 ComfyUI 版本、图标、横幅和项目链接；示例与中英文文档同步更新。

## English

- Added an explicitly authorized SGLang Omni/vLLM OpenAI-compatible remote inference connection; credentials never enter workflows.
- Added custom language hints, subtitle postprocessing/CPS reports, WebVTT/RTTM export, and optional overlap-evidence speaker linking across chunks.
- Added independent Whisper word alignment and WavLM X-Vector cross-chunk voice linking, bringing the pack to fifteen V3 nodes; auxiliary models are pinned, lazy-loaded, and independently releasable.
- Added pinned FLEURS provenance, per-file SHA-256 records, and a 30-minute noisy real-human-speech regression, while expanding automated coverage to Python 3.13, PyTorch 2.13.0, and Transformers 5.16.1.
- Added Registry minimum-ComfyUI metadata, icon/banner assets, project links, and updated examples plus bilingual documentation.
